origin.description: Text for each 8-bit color, drawn on that color as the background.
origin.details: Standard, high-intensity, 216-color, and grayscale bands. The 216-color band is filled down columns of a 36-by-6 matrix and then pasted down each column.

translation.description: Text for each 8-bit color, drawn on that color as the background.
translation.details: Standard, high-intensity, 216-color, and grayscale bands. Numbers are right-aligned the way R format aligns them.
